title: Which Charges a Telephone Payment on an Auto Loan Is Asked to Clear
content:
How far back the charges reach that a telephone payment on a loan of the Auto Loans line is asked to clear follows how many charges have been assessed on that loan over the last twelve months.

| Charges assessed on the loan in the last twelve months | The charges the payment must clear |
|---|---|
| No more than 3 | The charges assessed in the current calendar month, net of the corrections booked against them in that month |
| More than 3 but no more than 5 | The charges assessed in the last three calendar months, net of the corrections booked against them in those months |
| More than 5 | All the charges standing unpaid on the loan |

The charges the payment must clear are the charges assessed on the loan in the current calendar month net of the corrections booked against them in that month where no more than 3 charges have been assessed on the loan in the last twelve months.

They are the charges assessed in the last three calendar months net of the corrections booked against them in those months where more than 3 but no more than 5 charges have been assessed on the loan in the last twelve months.

They are all the charges standing unpaid on the loan where more than 5 charges have been assessed in that window.

## What the twelve-month count takes in

The count is of charges of every kind assessed on that one loan in the twelve months ending today: late charges, extension fees, returned payment fees and charges that became due again when a payment was returned. It is a count of entries, not a sum of their amounts.

## Where one row gives way to the next

A loan with exactly 3 charges assessed in the twelve months sits on the top row. A loan with 4 sits on the middle row, as does a loan with exactly 5. A loan with 6 sits on the bottom row.

## How the netting works on the top two rows

On the top two rows the corrections booked against those charges in the same window are netted off, so a charge of 25.00 corrected by 9.60 in the same month contributes 15.40 to the figure. On the bottom row the reading is what stands unpaid on the loan, where a correction has already reduced the unpaid figure itself.
